name: 15_turn_fan_knob
title: Operating Electric Fan and Inspecting Workspace
summary: A dual-arm robot turns on an electric fan, turns away to inspect items on a side table, and returns to turn the fan off.
robot: two robotic arms with black multi-jointed grippers
setting: an indoor office room with a white table and an orange chair

source.original_prompt: Twist the knob on the electric fan with right arm

segments.instruction: Right gripper reaches up toward the control knob on the top right of the white electric fan while left gripper stabilizes the frame.
Right gripper turns the knob clockwise to switch on the fan, then releases it.
Both grippers retract, and the camera turns left to face the side table with a miniature tree and blue bag.
segments.memory_event: hide: electric fan and main table leave view as the camera turns left

segments.instruction: Left gripper reaches toward the blue bag on the side table and gently adjusts its position.
Left gripper releases the blue bag and retracts while the camera remains focused on the side table.
Camera turns back to the center table, re-centering on the electric fan.
segments.memory_event: return: electric fan on the white table with its knob in the turned-on position and the orange chair behind it

segments.instruction: Right gripper reaches up and grasps the fan control knob again.
Right gripper turns the knob counterclockwise to turn off the fan, then releases it.
